notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Need for sharp is coming to release in a few days. But after this we won't stop and will continue adding content to game. There are some things that can be added:
[olist]
[b]1.[/b] Some history or prehistory. Now we have some ideas for history but they all very small or not interesting.

[b]2.[/b] More abilities and upgrades for player.

[b]3.[/b] Multiplayer.

[b]4.[/b] More Steam achievements.

[b]5.[/b] Localisate game to more languages.

[b]6.[/b] Add some bugs :)
[/olist]

With thanks,
N-Alt Lab
